name: Tamiraparani

source.name: Agastyarkoodam peak, Pothigai Hills, Western Ghats

sink.name: Gulf of Mannar
sink.location: Punnakayal, Thoothukudi district, Tamil Nadu, India

significance: only fully perennial river system in Tamil Nadu
drinking water and agriculture for Tirunelveli/Thoothukudi
did_you_know: Known in Sangam-era Tamil literature as the Porunai, the Tamiraparani is the only river system in Tamil Nadu that flows year-round without drying up.
The river's reddish tinge — the source of its name ("thamiram", copper) — comes from copper-bearing minerals it picks up flowing off the Western Ghats.
